script_package.title: 🤯 Your Body's SECRET Superpowers! #MindBlown
script_package.description: Did you know your bones are always changing, you have a second brain, and your immune system remembers everything? Get ready to be amazed by these hidden human body facts!
script_package.spoken_script: Ever wonder what crazy secrets your body is hiding? Get ready to have your mind blown! First up, your skeleton is basically a construction zone! Your bones are constantly dissolving and rebuilding. You get a completely new skeleton roughly every 10 years! Next, did you know you have a second "brain"? It's called your enteric nervous system, and it's in your gut! It can operate completely independently. And finally, your immune system has an incredible memory! It literally remembers past infections for years, even a lifetime. Pretty amazing, right?
